Lomifylline (rINN) Lomifilina; Lomifyllinum. 7-(5-Oxohexyl)theophylline. Ломифиллин C13H18N4O3 = 278.3. CAS — 10226-54-7. Profile Lomifylline is a theophylline derivative that has been used in preparations for cerebrovascular disorders. The dried flowering tops, whole or cut, of Lythrum salicaria. It contains not less than 5.0 % of tannins, expressed as pyrogallol and calculated with ref- erence to the dried drug. Protect from light. Profile Purple loosestrife, Lythrum salicaria (Lythraceae), is used in herbal medicine for the treatment of diarrhoea. It is also used for its astringent and antimicrobial properties. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Fr.: Salicairine.
